Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement axé sur les projets. Communication efficace avec les ingénieurs, gestionnaires de projet et parties prenantes. review_candidates.description: CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com. What You'll Do We're looking for a Senior Storage Engineer, File & Block to help build and operate the file and block storage services at the heart of CoreWeave's Storage team — the high-performance, multi-tenant storage that our largest AI training and inference workloads and internal stateful services run on. You'll help turn CoreWeave's storage from a follower of GPU growth into a multiplier of it: owning the data path and control plane for both file and block, running them on our own hardware fleet, and shipping the customer-facing capabilities that unblock petabyte-scale deals. You'll work closely with compute, platform, and infrastructure teams to make storage fast, reliable, and effortless to consume at scale. About The Role Design, build, and operate highly scalable, multi-tenant file and block storage — from the data path (NFS for file; durable, high-performance block volumes) to the control plane that governs tenancy, provisioning, and data protection — running natively on CoreWeave's storage fleet and delivered through Kubernetes. Own the file system data path: NFS hot-path reliability, IO resilience, and performance — including the small-file / IOPS-heavy workloads that AI pipelines depend on, and the throughput that keeps GPUs fed. Build a native block storage service: durable, high-performance block volumes for customer workloads and internal stateful services — the third leg of the file/object/block triad, running on our own data path and shared storage hardware. Deliver both file and block as first-class Kubernetes citizens: design and ship a backend-neutral CSI driver with dynamic provisioning, resize, snapshots, and RWO block volumes, backed by a public provisioning SLO — reusing shared control-plane and CSI patterns across file and block rather than rebuilding per service. Build the control plane: multi-tenant isolation, quota, QoS, snapshots, key management (BYOK), audit, and lifecycle policy — the capabilities that unblock regulated and enterprise customers (e.g., encryption in transit, HIPAA controls). Improve the reliability, durability, and observability of the storage stack; partner with operations to monitor, analyze, and optimize using telemetry, metrics, and dashboards to improve performance, latency, and resilience. Work cross-functionally with platform, product, and infrastructure teams to deliver seamless storage across the stack, including tiering cold data to lower-cost object storage while preserving access. Strong hands-on experience with distributed or networked file systems and/or block storage in production — e.g., NFS/POSIX file semantics at scale, and/or block volume services (durability, snapshots, replication). Depth in the storage data path: IO performance, caching, small-file and metadata-heavy workloads, crash consistency, and resilience under load. Experience with multi-tenant services or storage control planes — provisioning, tenancy/quota, and data-protection features (snapshots, encryption, key management). Proficiency in a systems/back-end language — Go strongly preferred (C or Rust a plus). Experience building on Kubernetes — controllers/operators, CRDs, and CSI (dynamic provisioning, resize, snapshots, RWO volumes). Familiarity with distributed databases (e.g., CockroachDB), workflow orchestration (e.g., Temporal), and gRPC/Protobuf service design. Ideally, experience with distributed or parallel storage stacks such as Ceph/RBD, Lustre, GPFS/Spectrum Scale, BeeGFS, WEKA, VAST, or DAOS. Familiarity with storage observability tools and telemetry pipelines (e.g., ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana). Bonus: exposure to high-performance data-path technologies (RDMA, GPUDirect Storage, RoCE, InfiniBand, SPDK). Strong debugging and problem-solving skills in distributed, high-performance environments. Clear communicator, able to work collaboratively across teams and share technical insights effectively. review_candidates.description: Project Manager – MICE (Corporate Events @ DMC) Location: Barcelona Employment type: Full-time, on-site About Nanoek Events Nanoek Events S.L. is a Destination Management Company specialising in meetings, incentives and corporate events throughout Spain. With more than 30 years of experience and offices in Barcelona and Madrid, we create tailored event experiences for international organisations, combining creativity, strategic thinking and precise execution. We work closely with our clients to understand their objectives, represent their brands and deliver every project to the highest operational standards. Our team is collaborative, hands-on and committed to quality, innovation and exceptional client service. About the Role We are looking for a motivated and client-focused Project Manager to join our Barcelona team. You will manage corporate events and destination programmes from the initial brief and creative proposal through planning, delivery, financial closure and post-event evaluation. This is a hands-on role requiring strong organisational and commercial skills, meticulous attention to detail and the ability to remain calm and solution-oriented in a fast-moving environment. For us, attitude is just as important as experience. We are looking for someone proactive, enthusiastic and reliable who takes ownership, supports the team and genuinely enjoys creating exceptional experiences for clients. Collaboration is an essential part of the role. The Project Manager will work closely with colleagues and project leads, actively incorporating their guidance, experience and feedback. Proposals, budgets and key client communications must be internally reviewed and aligned with the relevant team members before being presented to the client. Key ResponsibilitiesProject Planning and Development Understand client objectives and translate them into clear, creative and operationally viable event proposals. Develop comprehensive project plans, defining scope, deliverables, schedules, responsibilities and deadlines. Create event concepts, programmes and presentations in collaboration with clients and internal teams. Identify the personnel, equipment, materials and suppliers required for each project. Conduct risk assessments and prepare contingency plans. Client and Stakeholder Management Act as a key point of contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle. Maintain clear, fluid and professional communication with clients, suppliers and internal teams. Provide regular project updates and manage expectations effectively. Build lasting relationships based on trust, responsiveness and consistently high-quality service. Address concerns, resolve conflicts and anticipate potential challenges. Represent Nanoek Events professionally and identify opportunities to strengthen client relationships. Team Collaboration and Internal Alignment Work collaboratively with colleagues and project leads, actively incorporating their guidance, expertise and feedback throughout each project. Share relevant information openly and keep the team informed of project progress, challenges and client requests. Ensure that proposals, budgets and key client communications are internally reviewed and aligned before being presented to the client. Contribute constructively to team discussions and support decisions reached through collaboration and consensus. Respect agreed responsibilities, internal procedures and approval processes. Support colleagues when needed and contribute to a cooperative, solution-oriented working environment. Budget and Commercial Management Prepare, manage and monitor project budgets. Source suppliers and negotiate quotations, contracts and commercial conditions. Control costs and ensure each project meets its approved budget and profitability targets. Identify relevant upselling opportunities that add genuine value to the client’s programme. Support the development and retention of long-term client accounts. Event Logistics and Execution Coordinate all operational aspects of events, including venues, accommodation, catering, audiovisual production, transportation, staffing, entertainment and security. Carry out venue inspections, supplier checks and quality-control visits. Prepare detailed schedules, event run sheets, rooming lists, transportation plans and operational checklists. Coordinate internal teams, local suppliers and external event partners. Oversee event setup, live delivery and breakdown. Be present on-site and respond quickly and effectively to last-minute changes. Ensure every element of the event meets Nanoek Events’ standards and the client’s expectations. Quality Control and Evaluation Implement quality-control procedures before, during and after each event. Ensure services and materials are delivered on time and according to the agreed specifications. Conduct post-event evaluations and analyse client and supplier feedback. Identify areas for improvement and contribute to the continuous development of internal processes. Maintain accurate and organised project documentation. Project Administration and Financial Closure Maintain accurate financial records for every project. Ensure timely and correct client invoicing. Follow up on supplier invoices, payments and outstanding documentation. Close event files within the required timeframe. Review final project profitability and report any relevant variations. Skills and Experience Ideally, at least 1–2 years of experience in events, corporate travel, hospitality or destination management. Strong project management skills and the ability to coordinate several projects and stakeholders simultaneously. Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time-management abilities. Meticulous attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership. Commercial awareness, with a consultative and client-focused approach. Strong negotiation, problem-solving and decision-making skills. Ability to build solid relationships with clients, suppliers and colleagues. Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English and Spanish. Additional languages will be considered an advantage. Confidence using Microsoft Office and Canva to create professional presentations and project materials. Knowledge of Spain and enthusiasm for promoting the country as a leading MICE destination. A degree in Event Management, Business, Hospitality, Tourism or a related field is valued, although relevant professional experience is equally important. Availability to travel and work flexible hours when required by event operations. The Person We Are Looking For You are: Positive, enthusiastic and proactive. Highly motivated and results-driven. Client-focused and commercially minded. Calm and resourceful under pressure. Responsible, reliable and committed to delivering on your promises. Comfortable taking initiative while recognising when consultation and internal approval are required. Open to guidance and feedback, with the ability to respect and support agreed team decisions. Self-motivated while also being a genuine team player. Flexible and willing to support colleagues when needed. Curious, eager to learn and constantly looking for ways to improve. Passionate about events, hospitality and creating memorable client experiences. If you enjoy taking ownership of complex projects, collaborating with an experienced team and turning creative ideas into flawlessly delivered events, we would love to hear from you.
